title: Postgres transactions are a distributed systems superpower
summary: This article explores how PostgreSQL transactions can be leveraged as a powerful mechanism for building reliable distributed systems, specifically by co-locating workflow state directly with data in the database. It demonstrates how the ACID properties of Postgres can simplify complex workflow orchestration challenges that typically require elaborate distributed systems solutions.
problem_solved: It simplifies the complexity of building reliable distributed workflows by using database transactions as a native coordination mechanism instead of external workflow engines.
why_valuable: It offers a pragmatic approach to distributed systems by leveraging battle-tested database transaction semantics, reducing the need for complex external coordination systems.
